title: Common contract definitions
description: Shared wire formats from docs/specs/api-and-data.md section 1. Not a document on its own.

uuidv7.title: Uuidv7
uuidv7.description: Server-generated resource ID: lower-case UUIDv7 (version 7, RFC 9562 variant).

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Document, node, trigger and binding identifier.

catalogRef.title: CatalogRef
catalogRef.description: Reference to a catalog entry (network, connector, asset, feed, model or resource profile). Never a URL or address.

capabilityId.title: CapabilityId
capabilityId.description: Stable dotted capability or event type ID, for example price.read or swap.exactInput.

semver.title: SemVer
semver.description: Pinned catalog version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; no ranges or pre-release tags.

providerId.title: ProviderId
providerId.description: Namespaced opaque provider identifier, for example privy:abc123.

recordVersion.title: RecordVersion
recordVersion.description: Monotonic version of a budget, policy or other server record.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with exactly millisecond precision and Z suffix.

atomicAmount.title: AtomicAmount
atomicAmount.description: Non-negative asset amount in atomic units as a base-10 integer string, at most uint256.

positiveAtomicAmount.title: PositiveAtomicAmount
positiveAtomicAmount.description: Atomic amount greater than zero, at most uint256.

decimal.title: Decimal
decimal.description: Canonical decimal string: no exponent, no leading +, no leading or trailing zeros, no -0, at most 18 fractional digits.

nonNegativeDecimal.title: NonNegativeDecimal
nonNegativeDecimal.description: Canonical decimal string that is zero or positive.

usdMicros.title: UsdMicros
usdMicros.description: Non-negative USD valuation in integer micro-dollars as a base-10 string; separate from asset balances.

blockHeight.title: BlockHeight
blockHeight.description: Chain block height as a base-10 integer string (uint64).

hash32.title: Hash32
hash32.description: 32-byte hash (SHA-256 content hash, block or transaction hash) as lower-case 0x hex.

evmAddress.title: EvmAddress
evmAddress.description: EVM address in normalized lower-case comparison form. Mixed-case input is checksum-verified and normalized before it reaches a contract document.

traceId.title: TraceId
traceId.description: W3C trace-context trace ID: 32 lower-case hex characters.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Execution mode. Paper and live identities, balances and effects never mix.

money.title: Money
money.description: Amount of one catalog asset in atomic units.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price of one base asset expressed in an explicit quote unit, for example USD per paper.WETH.

generation.title: Generation
generation.description: Monotonic deployment generation as a base-10 integer string. Only the current generation may create new operations.

fencingToken.title: FencingToken
fencingToken.description: Monotonic lease fencing token as a base-10 integer string. A write carrying an older token is rejected.

iterationPath.title: IterationPath
iterationPath.description: Zero-based repeat iteration indices, outermost first; empty outside repeats (strategy-language.md section 8).

hostOperationKind.title: HostOperationKind
hostOperationKind.description: Interpreter host operation kinds supported by strategy/1.

boundRecord.title: BoundRecord
boundRecord.description: Named typed values, each an evaluated strategy literal (the interpreter's BoundValue); never an expression to evaluate.

safeText.title: SafeText
safeText.description: Bounded user-safe text without control characters.

opaqueKey.title: OpaqueKey
opaqueKey.description: Opaque printable identifier such as a deployment revision or source event key.

capabilityGrant.title: CapabilityGrant
capabilityGrant.description: Short-lived bearer capability for one assignment (at most five minutes). Secret: never logged, stored or echoed; servers keep only its hash.

assetIdentity.title: AssetIdentity
assetIdentity.description: Resolved asset identity; never a symbol alone. Mainnet, testnet, fork and paper registries are distinct networkRefs.

nativeAssetIdentity.title: NativeAssetIdentity
nativeAssetIdentity.description: The chain's native gas asset (MON on Monad). Wrapped native tokens are erc20 identities.

paperAssetIdentity.title: PaperAssetIdentity
paperAssetIdentity.description: Synthetic paper-registry asset. Has no chain ID or contract address so it can never be mistaken for an on-chain asset.
